brief:
Prime Minister Andy Burnham has rejected former Labour leader Jeremy Corbyn's call for a public inquiry into British complicity in Gaza's conflict, Middle East Eye reported. Corbyn, who wrote to Burnham after his July appointment as prime minister, urged him to establish a "full" inquiry into the matter.

The specifics of Burnham's rejection and his stated rationale were not detailed in the available material.

title: Burnham rebuffs Corbyn's demand for Gaza genocide inquiry
